scope: Actual FrameNodeGeometry, FrameNodeDrawing, FrameNodeRenderer, FrameNodeStore and FrameNodeCommand with explicit in-memory CAD/prompt/canonical-zone seams. Direct snapshot fixture bypasses the old 2B2 resolver only for the exact renderer/store boundary; the command test invokes the actual existing resolver and rejects drift before UI and writes.

numeric_contract.renderer_store_assertions: Exact IEEE754 bits in stored selection, reevaluated summary, planes/layers/dimensions, actual CAD Line X coordinates, and exact cladding dimension MText. No tolerance widening.
numeric_contract.command_assertions: If the existing project resolver drifts from exact raw declaration, E_NODE_SOURCE_PRECISION before form and no database mutation. Otherwise actual command create and check must preserve exact bits and report current.

coverage_limits: CAD object model and prompts are explicit test doubles, not a running AutoCAD host.
The old 2B2 resolver is unchanged; affected raw declarations are refused at the new node boundary.
Native COPY, Undo, UCS/DUCS and Save/reopen remain part of the future live pilot.
